grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings exceed C-band ceiling (max_p1: 2 per config). Services offline — performance-profiler and chaos-monkey ran static-only.

escalations.title: Portal/Backend OpenTelemetry ecosystem has 4 critical CVEs
escalations.summary: 25 known issues in @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node + 12 CVEs in protobufjs. If telemetry pipeline ingests PII or auth tokens, actively exploitable.
escalations.action: Audit telemetry data scope before dismissing. Pin and review OTel package versions.

escalations.title: PostCSS path traversal via sourceMappingURL (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q)
escalations.summary: PostCSS auto-loads source maps from CSS sourceMappingURL without validation. Arbitrary file read possible if app processes untrusted CSS. CVSS 7.5.
escalations.action: Determine if any code path processes untrusted CSS. Update postcss regardless.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer scope is critically narrow — covers 10% of spec requirements
p1_findings.detail: The enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/. portal/ — which implements the majority of domain requirements — is never scanned. The gate reports 100% pass on 13 of ~134 spec requirements.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: An agent edits portal/ code, introduces spec drift, and CI passes. The gate is not protecting portal/ at all.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add 'portal' to source_dirs in tools/traceability-enforcer.py. Also add enforcement for all Specifications/ FRs, not just Plans/*/requirements.md.

p1_findings.title: Raw SQL in route handler — no service layer
p1_findings.detail: Route handler directly calls db.prepare('SELECT * FROM team_dispatches...').all() and db.prepare('INSERT INTO team_dispatches...').run(). All other portal routes use the service layer.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any future parameterised input (team name from URL) hits the DB directly with no service-level validation. Creates injection footgun.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extract portal/Backend/src/services/teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches() and createDispatch(). Route delegates to service only.

p1_findings.title: Brace-expansion multiple DoS vulnerabilities (CVSS 7.5)
p1_findings.detail: 4 CVEs: GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp (exponential expansion), GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (OOM), GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (bypass), GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (quadratic time).
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Crafted brace patterns exhaust CPU or RAM. Primary build-time vector; runtime risk if app exposes globbing to user input.
p1_findings.recommendation: Run npm ls brace-expansion to identify chain. Add overrides entry in package.json to pin to patched version.

p1_findings.title: Portal/Backend OpenTelemetry ecosystem has 4 critical CVEs
p1_findings.detail: 25 known issues in @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node + 12 CVEs in protobufjs. portal/Backend is the highest-risk workspace.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: If OTel pipeline ingests PII or auth tokens and a protobuf deserialization CVE is triggered, attacker can leak or corrupt telemetry data including request context.
p1_findings.recommendation: ESCALATE to TheGuardians. Audit telemetry data scope. Pin and review OTel versions. Consider explicit per-library instrumentation instead of auto-instrumentations.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline spec (FR-TMP-001–010) has zero implementation
p2_findings.detail: 10 requirements covering risk classification, auto-PR, AI review, and auto-merge have no Verifies: comments anywhere.
p2_findings.recommendation: Mark spec as 'Status: Planned / Not Yet Implemented' OR create a Plans entry and implement it.

p2_findings.title: 3 recently-added portal files have no traceability comments
p2_findings.detail: All three modified in last 14 days with zero // Verifies: comments. Cannot be detected by enforcer since portal/ is not scanned (QO-001).
p2_findings.recommendation: Identify governing spec/FR for each file. Add // Verifies: <FR-ID> comments or write the spec first.

p2_findings.title: Empty .catch(() => {}) silently swallows errors in 3 files
p2_findings.detail: Silent error suppression on repos.list() calls. Violates: 'Never swallow errors silently'. Users get no feedback; failures are invisible to operators.
p2_findings.recommendation: At minimum: .catch(err => console.warn('repo load failed', err)). Prefer setting error state for user feedback.

p2_findings.title: body-parser DoS via trailing bytes after compressed body (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828)
p2_findings.detail: Trailing bytes after compressed request body bypass size enforcement. Attacker triggers via HTTP POST with Content-Encoding: gzip + crafted body.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update body-parser (requires express or middleware bump). Fix via express version bump.

p2_findings.title: browserslist unbounded memory growth (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx, CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: Cache without eviction policy causes unbounded memory growth. Attacker controlling browser list queries triggers OOM.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update browserslist across all workspaces.

p2_findings.title: PostCSS path traversal via sourceMappingURL (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.detail: postcss auto-loads source maps from CSS sourceMappingURL without validation. Arbitrary file read if app processes untrusted CSS.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update postcss. Determine if any code path processes untrusted CSS input. ESCALATE to TheGuardians if yes.

p3_findings.title: Plan-originated FRs (FR-070–095) not backed by Specifications/
p3_findings.recommendation: Move FR-070–095 into Specifications/image-upload.md to maintain spec-first workflow.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 4 production files
p3_findings.recommendation: Review each suppression; add explaining comment or extract to useCallback/useMemo.

p3_findings.title: interface TeamDispatch defined inline in route file — not in Shared types
p3_findings.recommendation: Move TeamDispatch to portal/Shared/types.ts and import it. Resolve together with QO-002.

p3_findings.title: React Router open redirect via protocol-relative URL (GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update @remix-run/router or react-router-dom. Audit route handlers that follow user-supplied redirect URLs.

p3_findings.title: Vite build tool vulnerabilities (9 CVEs, path traversal in dev server)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update to latest stable Vite 5.x. Primarily dev-time risk.

p3_findings.title: Vitest mocker path traversal + code injection (GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9, GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8)
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vitest to 4.1.12+. Test-time risk; could affect CI/CD if tests run untrusted code.

cross_reference_map.root_cause: teamDispatches.ts route not refactored to service pattern
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Extract teamDispatchService.ts; move TeamDispatch to portal/Shared/types.ts
Install Renovate/Dependabot; run npm update for patched packages
